reviews.review: This game gives me a mega Nut

The game is tedious as hell. The enemies have WAY too many hp, and you walk so painfully slowly. The enemies do little damage but the difficulty comes from the fact that it takes a good 30+ seconds just to kill an enemy later in the game. By then some more enemies will spawn. Mind you, I'm talking about regular enemies later in the game, not bosses. It takes so much time to kill enemies that it feels like it's not worth bothering with, but then it's required to kill off the enemies to use the teleporter to the next stage. Honestly, the game concept is fine, but the balancing is way off. You don't need nigh indestructable enemies to make a hard game. See Ninja Gaiden for example. High hp just makes it a chore.

Apparently, one of the updates added an option (aka an artifact) to massively increase the damage dealt and damage taken. This sounds like it could make the game playable. Unfortunately, it's not unlocked from the start, and I don't know if it's worth the time to try and figure out how to unlock it.

Exploring the map is also painful because you walk slowly and have a tiny jump height. The crappy map design is such that platforms are WAY to high to jump to, and require you to walk out of the way to find ropes or geysers to propel you up to the platforms. This is very, very tedious. Jumping down a platform to kill a straggling enemy (did I mention you have to hunt down every enemy to proceed?) requires you to make a long walk to get back up. This is pretty much every platform on every map! Why are the platform separations at a much larger scale than your default movement capabilities?

Also, the graphics are, well, not good. The characters are tiny and lack any definition, and the landscape is drab and repetitive. I'm not sure what the advantage of using such small characters is, except that I suppose it's easier to fit more players on the screen. There isn't much graphical "juice" to indicate scoring hits or taking damage. The game revolves around ability cooldowns but there isn't any animation or sound cue to indicate when a cooldown is ready. You know, a little shine or sound blip could have made things a lot better. All you get is a box with a number in it which counts down. Why not animate the box as well, with a bar filling up or a dial spinning around?

Bought this for the multiplayer, but that game mode is not possible without port forwarding or using Hamachi (which after a dozen tries didn't work either.)
It's pretty rude form the devs to sell this in a 4-Games bundle and market the game as a multiplayer game when you can't even use that feature properly.
I'm glad I got it during sale for 2.50.

I bought it because it was very cheap. I stopped playing it because it takes too long. Too many things need to be unlocked.

What i find very discouraging is that there are a lot of playable characters with different abilities, but you only start with 1.

There is a lot of stuff to unlock but why should it be unlocked?

why not just let it be available from the start?

I don't want to play the commando for 3 hours just to unlock a different class.

I don't want to complete random tasks to unlock random items that I might only see once an hour or less.

This game would be a LOT more fun if everything was just open to use from the start.

The game might not cost a lot of money, but it costs too much time.
